# Document blueprints

- [Team policy](team-spec.md) - Define durable coordination policy independently of task progress.

- [Plan template](plan.md) - Save a tracked plan with baseline and compatibility sections when existing contracts are affected.
- [Micro spec template](micro-spec.md) - Define one observable behavior and the method used to verify it.
- [Task catalog](catalog.md) - Choose one task contract from its intended outcome and required evidence.
- [Implementation](micro-spec-implementation.md) - Specify an artifact, behavior change, or behavior-preserving structural improvement.
- [Bugfix](micro-spec-bugfix.md) - Reproduce a contract violation and verify its repair.
- [Review](micro-spec-review.md) - Assess a defined scope and report supported findings and verification limits.
- [Investigation](micro-spec-investigation.md) - Connect a scoped explanation to observed evidence.
- [Design](micro-spec-design.md) - Record a system decision, alternatives, and compatibility review.
- [Research](micro-spec-research.md) - Answer a bounded question using attributable source evidence.
- [Runbook](micro-spec-runbook.md) - Author an operating procedure with verified commands and limits.
- [Goal](goal.md) - Define bounded execution, completion criteria, linked work, and recovery.
- [Agent role](agent-role.md) - Define optional reusable mission, trigger, authority, output, and escalation instructions.
- [Delegation brief](delegation-brief.md) - Assign a bounded part of the current spec without duplicating acceptance or progress.
- [Worker result](worker-result.md) - Return observed results, evidence, gaps, and a next action to the progress owner.
